welcome: A clearer view of your farm.
overviewSub: Current regional weather from a model; farm sensors are not connected.
sampleNote: No on-farm sensors are connected; field and equipment measurements are unavailable.
head: Pumping head (m)
formula: ETc = Kc × ET₀ · Net = max(0, ETc − 0.8 × rain) · Volume = 10 × gross depth × hectares
solarMethod: Simplified solar: kWp × equivalent sun hours × 0.80. Pump: ρgVH / (η × 3,600,000).
solarWindow: Pump during the solar window, approximately 10:00–15:00, subject to available power and storage.
backupEnergy: Shift demand to solar hours or size a reviewed backup energy source for the deficit.
mulch: Model a 10% reduction in demand through soil cover; validate locally before applying.
coolHours: Irrigate in cooler hours and monitor root-zone moisture. Model assumes 10% lower demand.
prioritize: Allocate the limited supply to the priority 70% of the cultivated area.
isolateLeak: Isolate and repair the affected pipe. Model assumes 90% of leakage is recovered.
repairPump: Restore pumping or use a backup pump. Model assumes 80% delivery recovery.
verifySensor: Quarantine the suspect reading and compare it with an independent measurement.
darcy: Simplified Darcy–Weisbach · 300 m pipe · Ø 80 mm · f 0.025 · 8 h/day
harvestEstimate: Harvest = rain × roof area × 0.8 / 1,000, capped by empty storage capacity.
regionalNote: Regional comparison shows Open-Meteo weather-model output, not measured farm conditions.
mapNote: Illustrative field locations. Map tiles require internet; field controls remain available offline.
noDevices: Add a validated Studio design to see it here.
scenarioAssumptions: Illustrative interventions, not measured savings. Restriction preserves the supply limit; backup energy is additional supply. Repair, cover and backup pump assumptions are stated in each action.
scenarioHelp: Change one condition and compare reproducible water and energy outcomes.
insightsText: Calculations use the farm values you enter and weather-model inputs. They are estimates, not measured field outcomes.
securityText: Simulated telemetry checks: out-of-range moisture, frozen readings, abrupt jumps and high flow with low pressure. This is not a live security service.
leakDetected: Suspected leak: flow is over 130% of baseline and pressure is below 80%.
sensorFrozen: Five identical moisture readings: possible frozen sensor.
sensorJump: Moisture jumped more than 25 percentage points.
noAlerts: No anomalies detected in these samples.
studioSub: From an idea to an inspectable engineering proposal.
promptExample: Design a solar-powered irrigation controller for my 5-hectare olive farm. Monitor soil moisture and detect leaks.
prompt: Describe your system or request a change
designUpdated: Proposal saved. Inspect the connections, assumptions and validation before proceeding.
unsupportedRequest: This request is outside the supported irrigation catalogue; robots and drones are not supported. Nothing was saved. Try “solar irrigation controller” for a new design, or “add another soil sensor”, “replace Wi-Fi with LoRa” or “reduce cost” for an existing design.
pumpQuestion: What are the real pump voltage, current, head and flow? The included 60 W pump is a bench demonstration, not sized for a 5 ha farm.
rangeQuestion: What communication distance and local radio-frequency rules apply?
batteryQuestion: What autonomy, battery chemistry and outdoor enclosure rating are required?
qualifiedReview: Engineering proposal only. A qualified professional must review component datasheets, wiring, protection and installation.
confirmRequirements: Confirm pump load, cable lengths, radio rules, battery chemistry and required autonomy.
powerOff: Disconnect all energy sources before assembly; fit a suitable enclosure and protection.
checkRails: Verify regulated rails with a meter. ESP32 GPIO accepts 3.3 V logic; DevKit VIN uses the reviewed 5 V regulator.
connectSensors: Wire sensor signals to the listed pins with a common signal ground. Use reviewed pulse level shifting and an analog divider for the 5 V sensors.
testDryRun: Load the dry-run starter. It reads raw soil ADC values and holds the pump off. Calibrate sensors and verify every input before commissioning.
protectPump: Use a rated transistor driver, flyback protection, fuses and switching hardware selected for pump startup current.
fieldCalibration: Validate thresholds, communications, fail-safe shutdown and water delivery on site before enabling automation.
voltageMismatch: ESP32 logic supply must be between 3.0 and 3.6 V.
adcExhausted: Insufficient ADC1 inputs for the requested sensors.
pinConflict: Pressure and soil sensors share GPIO 39.
driverCheck: Relay driver and level conversion included
powerCheck: Regulator and protection included; load sizing requires review
reviewDatasheet: Illustrative catalogue specification; confirm the selected vendor datasheet.
espSupply: 5 V DevKit VIN; internal 3.3 V GPIO. Never apply 5 V to GPIO.
levelShiftRequired: 5 V pulse output requires level shifting to 3.3 V.
dividerRequired: Analog divider must limit maximum output to 3.3 V; not a digital level shifter.
relayDriver: Do not power a relay coil from GPIO; use the transistor driver.
benchPump: 12 V / 5 A bench pump; startup current and farm hydraulic sizing are not validated.
flyback: Fit flyback protection for inductive loads.
chargeControllerRequired: A panel must connect through a compatible charge controller.
batteryFuse: Fuse at the battery terminal; size conductors and disconnects.
chargeProfile: Select a controller charge profile matching the battery chemistry.
regulatorRating: Use a reviewed 12 V → 5 V regulator with sufficient peak current.
regionalRadio: Select radio frequency and duty cycle under local rules; gateway is not included.
fuseEnclosure: Fuses, disconnect, cables and outdoor enclosure require project-specific selection.
analog33: ADC signal must remain within 0–3.3 V.
logic33: 3.3 V logic with a shared signal ground.
accessibilityHelp: Preferences are saved on this device. All design actions are available with a keyboard.
weatherUnavailable: Weather service unavailable; no weather values are shown.
error: The request failed. Check the backend and try again.
noResult: Run a calculation or simulation to see the result.
inspectConnection: Select a component to inspect its specification. Connections are listed below.
supplyNote: All quantities are estimates. Prices in USD exclude shipping, installation and farm-scale pump sizing.
riskNote: Stress = net daily demand / 8 mm, capped at 100%. Illustrative indicator; soil water storage is not modeled.
scenarioDevice: Studio devices are represented in the twin; intervention effects use the explicit scenario assumptions.
networkHelp: A constant-head source feeds two series pipes. Flow and pressure are estimated, not calibrated telemetry.
versionConflict: Another update was saved. Reopen the project and retry.
incompatibleDesign: Resolve compatibility issues before adding this device.
lengthMismatch: Telemetry arrays must have equal lengths.
inputNote: Calculated from the values you entered and illustrative crop coefficients; this is not a measured irrigation requirement.
forecastApplied: Weather values applied to the irrigation inputs. Recalculate to update results.
connectionExplanation: Soil probes feed the listed 3.3 V ADC pins. The 5 V flow pulse goes through level conversion to GPIO 27; pressure uses a separate analog divider to GPIO 39. GPIO 26 drives a transistor, which switches the relay coil; the relay switches the separately fused pump supply. Inspect each connection below for its rule. Power and ground wiring must be reviewed before assembly.
homeIntro: View Open-Meteo current model weather by administrative region. No farm sensors are connected; calculations require your own farm inputs.
homeJourneySteps: Choose a country and administrative region. Review current model weather and the seven-day forecast.
In Agriculture, enter actual farm parameters. Optionally copy weather-model inputs, then review the labeled calculation estimate.
Water, Energy, Simulator, Insights and Security remain unavailable until live farm meters or sensor data are connected.
Use Studio to draft hardware concepts; a design is not connected to or deployed on equipment.
homeDataNote: Changing region loads that region’s weather-model data. Farm values are not prefilled.
homeBeginnerMode: Beginner explains each section in plain language, with inputs, steps and help reading results.
homeProMode: Pro adds methods, units, assumptions and data provenance to the same guides.
homeModeHelp: Use the switch above at any time. Both modes have the same features and calculations. Your choice is remembered on this browser.
homeSectionMapHelp: Every section includes a guide. Open one below to follow its steps.
homeScopeNote: Current weather is regional model output, not a station measurement. Farm calculations are estimates from your inputs. No hardware is controlled.

overview.purpose: View current regional model weather and its seven-day forecast.
steps: Select a region.
Review current model conditions and the forecast.
Use Agriculture only after entering values from your farm.
overview.results: Weather-model values for the administrative center grid; no farm measurements are available.
overview.beginner: Open-Meteo current conditions are 15-minute model output, not a local station reading.
overview.professional: The overview does not include seeded farms, synthetic telemetry or calculated baselines. Weather is coordinate-based model output and may differ from field conditions.

comparison.purpose: Compare weather-model output across administrative regions.
comparison.inputs: Country; Tunisia includes all 24 governorates and Japan all 47 prefectures.
steps: Choose a country.
Compare the regional weather forecasts.
Select a region to open its current weather.
comparison.results: A comparison of regional model data, not measured conditions on farms.
comparison.beginner: No farm or sensor readings are included.
comparison.professional: Each region is queried at its administrative-center coordinate. The provider returns model values, not station observations.

twin.purpose: View an administrative-center map point and its regional weather.
steps: Select a region.
Read its center coordinate and current model weather.
Farm boundaries and devices appear only after real data sources are connected.
twin.results: The map locates the administrative center only; it does not show a surveyed farm or sensor.
twin.beginner: This is not yet a live farm digital twin.
twin.professional: The map marker is the administrative-center coordinate; farm shapes and device telemetry are not generated.

agriculture.purpose: Calculate an irrigation estimate from supplied farm parameters.
agriculture.inputs: Your actual crop, stage, area, efficiencies, pump and solar specifications, and weather inputs.
steps: Enter values from your farm; no example values are prefilled.
Optionally copy ET0, rainfall and radiation-derived sun hours from the labeled Open-Meteo forecast.
Calculate and review the estimate and its assumptions.
agriculture.results: Formula-based calculations from the values you entered; they are not measured water use.
agriculture.beginner: Use accurate field and equipment values. Model weather inputs and crop coefficients add uncertainty.
agriculture.professional: The calculation is labeled estimated and uses reference Kc values and simplified formulas; it has no root-zone model or field calibration.

water.purpose: Live flow, pressure and network views require installed meters and a real network description.
water.inputs: Farm inputs and Calculate; daily allocation (m³), roof area (m²) and storage capacity (m³).
steps: Connect and configure water meters first.
This page shows no assumed or simulated readings.
water.results: Unavailable until live telemetry is connected.
water.beginner: No flow or pressure sensors are connected yet.
water.professional: Synthetic Darcy network outputs are not exposed in the live workspace.

energy.purpose: Live energy tracking requires a connected inverter or energy meter.
energy.inputs: Farm water demand, pump head (m), pump efficiency, solar capacity (kWp) and equivalent sun hours.
steps: Connect an energy meter.
This page shows no assumed generation or pump usage.
energy.results: Unavailable until live energy telemetry is connected.
energy.beginner: Solar and pump meters are not connected yet.
energy.professional: Calculated kWh values require real hardware inputs and are not reported as measurements.

simulator.purpose: Scenario results are simulations, not live farm data.
simulator.inputs: Scenario, severity, intervention toggle and farm inputs under Calculate.
steps: Scenario execution is disabled in the live workspace.
Connect farm telemetry before building data-driven interventions.
simulator.results: No synthetic scenario outputs are shown.
simulator.beginner: This page will remain unavailable until real telemetry is integrated.
simulator.professional: The simulation API rejects requests until a live data source is connected.

insights.purpose: Operational insights require connected farm measurements.
insights.inputs: Calculate in Agriculture first, or inspect the initial regional estimate.
steps: Connect and verify farm sensors.
Then calculate recommendations from measured data and labeled model weather.
insights.results: Unavailable without field and equipment telemetry.
insights.beginner: No recommendations are generated from demo values.
insights.professional: The live insights view does not use threshold rules over example data.

security.purpose: Live anomaly analysis requires connected sensor telemetry.
security.inputs: Normal, leak, tampering, frozen sensor or sudden sensor jump.
steps: Connect real flow, pressure and soil sensors.
Then analyze timestamped readings.
security.results: Unavailable until real sensor data is integrated.
security.beginner: No sample sensor arrays are presented as real readings.
security.professional: Only explicitly submitted telemetry can be analyzed; there is no device ingestion yet.

studio.purpose: Create and revise a catalogue-based irrigation hardware concept.
studio.inputs: A supported irrigation request, then power, network and profile choices; or a saved project.
steps: Create a supported irrigation design.
Review its components and illustrative prices.
Export the concept; hardware deployment is disabled until a connector exists.
studio.results: Versions preserve each accepted edit. Compatibility checks highlight a limited set of electrical issues; the ZIP includes design, parts, connections, guide and starter firmware.
studio.beginner: Designs are concepts; the backend does not connect or deploy physical hardware.
studio.professional: Local keyword rules use a fixed catalogue (generation provenance is recorded; an optional configured provider can plan within it). USD prices are illustrative; the 60 W pump is a bench example. Geometry is conceptual, wiring is unreviewed and firmware is uncompiled.

settings.purpose: Adjust accessibility and refresh regional model weather.
settings.inputs: Language, contrast, text size and motion settings.
steps: Adjust display preferences.
Refresh current model weather.
Check provider source and model-valid time.
settings.results: Current Open-Meteo model values and a seven-day forecast.
settings.beginner: No fallback or sample weather is shown if the provider fails.
settings.professional: Current weather is 15-minute model output; it is not station telemetry.

studioAiScope: The model interprets your requirements. Catalogue rules build the design and run compatibility checks. This is a conceptual proposal, not validated hardware.
studioAiWorking: The model is planning your design. The first request may take up to 90 seconds.
studioAiUnavailable: The AI model could not return a usable plan. Nothing was saved. Check that the model server is running and the model is downloaded, then try again. A simpler request may help.
weatherGridNote: Open-Meteo current conditions use 15-minute weather-model data for this regional grid; they are not local station measurements.
noFarmTelemetry: No farm sensors are connected. Soil, flow, pressure, pump and on-farm weather readings are unavailable.
regionCoordinatesOnly: This point marks the administrative center, not a surveyed farm.
realFarmInputsOnly: Enter values from your real farm. No example farm values are prefilled. Results are calculations, not measurements.
farmInputsRequired: Enter all required values from your real farm before calculating.
noWaterTelemetry: No live flow meter, pressure sensor, or water network feed is connected.
noEnergyTelemetry: No live solar inverter or energy meter is connected.
scenarioLiveUnavailable: Scenario outputs are simulations, so they are disabled in the live workspace.
securityLiveUnavailable: Live security analysis is unavailable until real sensor telemetry is connected.
modelWeatherPolicy: Current conditions and the forecast come from Open-Meteo weather models. They are not readings from a local station.
useWeatherForecastInputs: Use Open-Meteo forecast for weather inputs
calculationEstimate: Calculated estimate from your farm values, reference crop coefficients, and the labeled weather model; not a sensor measurement.
weatherUpdates: The app refreshes weather every 10 minutes. The displayed time is the model-valid time.
